idle.notes: Reviewed white-background candidate: pigment circulates, spiral identity and pooled origin remain coherent; no human gait.

walk_forward.notes: Reviewed full-body liquid wave and dripping deformation; no stepping limbs, clean bounds.

walk_back.notes: Reviewed recoiling pigment curls and core compression; no humanoid knees or feet.

jump.notes: Reviewed pool compression, upward teardrop extension, and recoil; all tips contained.

landing.notes: Reviewed broad paint-pool squash and upward reformation; no cropped splash.

crouch.notes: Selected source 0–57 so held crouch ends as a low pool instead of returning to standing.

block.notes: Reviewed outer-coil shield curling around the teal core; same palette and scale.

hurt.notes: Reviewed subtle leftward dent and liquid recoil, appropriate for a brief interrupt.

getup.notes: Selected source 35 onward: starts pooled, rises and restores the recognizable spiral without a standing prelude.

dash_forward.notes: Reviewed horizontal elastic smear and recovery around a stationary root; runtime supplies translation.

ribbon_jab.notes: Reviewed rightward crimson ribbon unfurling and retracting; complete extension visible.

undertow.notes: Reviewed low lavender ribbon traveling right along the ground; no human kick.

rising_ochre.notes: Reviewed high golden-edged liquid whip; tip remains inside expanded canvas.

impasto.notes: Reviewed whole-core swell, rightward lean, and recoil; preserves scale and palette.

bind.notes: Reviewed rightward looping ribbon, curling closure and retraction; runtime tether handles contact and pull.

summon.notes: Reviewed opening core and framing ribbon gesture; no hands baked into body art.

hands_idle.notes: Reviewed exactly two detached hands, subtle finger motion and single visible needle.

needle_thrust.notes: Reviewed upper-hand rightward needle thrust, lower-hand follow and return; needle remains legible.

hands_pinch.notes: Reviewed two floating hands opening and curling toward contact space; pair remains separate from body.

hands_recall.notes: Reviewed hands spiraling into paint ribbons; early dismissal occurs at the contraction pose.
